layers.api: src/index.ts: the public API; re-exports exactly slugify, titleCase, wordCount and truncate

invariants.TK-API: src/index.ts exports slugify, titleCase, wordCount and truncate as functions
invariants.STRUCT-SELF-CONTAINED: the bundle is src/ only: relative imports inside src/, no packages, runtime modules or dynamic code
invariants.TK-SLUG-ASCII: slugify lowercases and joins ASCII letter/digit runs with single dashes, no leading or trailing dash
invariants.TK-SLUG-DIACRITICS: slugify folds characters by NFKD and drops combining marks before slugging
invariants.TK-TITLE-CASE: titleCase lowercases, then uppercases the first character at the start or after whitespace; whitespace is preserved
invariants.TK-WORD-COUNT: wordCount counts maximal runs of Unicode letters or digits
invariants.TK-TRUNCATE: truncate returns fitting text unchanged, otherwise max-1 code points plus an ellipsis; max 0 yields empty
invariants.TK-TRUNCATE-RANGE: truncate throws RangeError for a negative or non-integer max
invariants.TK-TRUNCATE-CODE-POINTS: truncate counts Unicode code points, never splitting a surrogate pair

performance.metric: bundleBytes: total bytes of every file under src/ (deterministic; one repetition)
performance.acceptance: correctness passes and bundleBytes shrinks below the current best by at least the acceptance margin
